name: taxpresso
description: Your taxes, done over an espresso. Prepare your Geneva tax return with Claude; your documents stay on this computer.
long_description:
Taxpresso helps you prepare your Geneva tax return (déclaration d'impôt) with Claude. It runs entirely on your computer: it makes no network requests, and your documents never leave your Taxpresso folder unless you ask Claude to read one.

This preview asks the questions that matter for your return, in the chat or in its dashboard, keeps your documents in your Taxpresso folder, reads them with Claude when you ask (you confirm every value), checks them against each other, tells you what is still missing, estimates what a pillar 3a payment before 31 December would save you, and later checks your assessment against what you declared. The full tax calculation comes in the next versions.

Taxpresso is free and open source (GNU AGPL-3.0-or-later).

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Where your Geneva tax return stands: household, questions answered, documents, what is still missing and the next step.

tools.name: next_questions
tools.description: The next questions about your situation.

tools.name: answer_question
tools.description: Saves your answer to a question.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: Your documents and what each one is.

tools.name: ingest_vault
tools.description: Adds files you put in your Taxpresso folder yourself.

tools.name: list_optimizations
tools.description: Ways to lower your tax with their CHF value. For now: pillar 3a before 31 December.

tools.name: set_fact
tools.description: Saves what you tell Claude: a rough figure for the estimates, a value from a document you confirmed or corrected, or a note on something to check.

tools.name: get_document_for_review
tools.description: Shows Claude one of your documents, when you ask: its text, extracted on this computer, or the image of a photo or scan.

tools.name: propose_extraction
tools.description: Saves the values Claude read in a document, with their page and box, for you to confirm.

tools.name: get_holdings
tools.description: Your securities list (état des titres) and other wealth: each line, whose it is, its value and income, the withholding tax you get back, and what is missing.

tools.name: set_holding
tools.description: Saves what you tell Claude about your securities and accounts: the official value of a security, whose a line is, or an account or asset without a document.

tools.name: open_dashboard
tools.description: Opens your Taxpresso dashboard, which runs on this computer only.

prompts.name: start_geneva_tax_return
prompts.description: Begin or pick up your Geneva tax return with Taxpresso.
prompts.text: I want to work on my Geneva tax return with Taxpresso. Check where I am and tell me the next step.

vault_path.title: Taxpresso folder
vault_path.description: Where your tax documents and records are kept. Taxpresso creates it if needed. It is a normal folder you can open and back up; don't choose a folder inside a code project.

ui_language.title: Dashboard language
ui_language.description: en for English, fr for French. Claude answers in the language you write in.
